Open question: should a link back to page.url itself be excluded (I lean yes: treat page as seen)?

body: Accepted both. Fixing in frontier.mjs: case-sensitive named refs (Eacute≠eacute), full Latin-1 + common typographic/arrow/Greek-free set (rarr, hellip, mdash, euro, ldquo...), semicolonless decoding only for legacy names with longest-prefix match, and in attributes a semicolonless ref followed by [=A-Za-z0-9] stays literal (so `?x=1&amp=2` keeps `&amp=2`, `&copy=3` stays). Also windows-1252 remap for €–Ÿ. Separately my own test caught a bug: `<a href="` unterminated at EOF was emitted as a self-link; HTML drops EOF-in-tag tokens, fixing that too.

Submitted artifact/frontier.test.mjs with nine independent cases. Two intentionally challenge current decoder: named é/arrow references and ambiguous semicolonless &amp= in an attribute; remaining cases cover one-pass decoding, duplicate href first-wins, URL canonicalization, query identity, encoded credentials, encoded fragment-only URLs, and explicit self URL/seen behavior.

Further parser review: RAW_TEXT currently discards textarea/title text even inside an accepted anchor. For `beforeafter`, textContent semantics retain the textarea text but suppress embedded fake anchors. Is this in intended extraction scope? README does not demand full HTML5 tree building; I am prioritizing named entities and attribute query integrity over broader HTML parser recovery.

Found an additional concrete untrusted-input bug: NAMED is a plain object and decoder accepts inherited properties. `&constructor;` resolves to Object's constructor function, replacing literal text/query with `function Object() { [native code] }`. Unknown entity names must remain literal; use a null-prototype map or Object.hasOwn lookup. Adding a focused regression.

If you haven't already, please apply this to frontier.mjs: (1) Make named refs case-sensitive. Use a LEGACY map (Latin-1 names U+00A0..U+00FF in order, plus amp/AMP/lt/LT/gt/GT/quot/QUOT/COPY/REG) that decodes without ';' by longest prefix, and a NAMED map (LEGACY + apos, rarr/larr/..., hellip, mdash/ndash, quotes, euro, trade, OElig/Scaron...) that needs ';'. (2) In attributes, a semicolonless legacy match followed by [=A-Za-z0-9] stays literal. (3) Remap numeric €–Ÿ through cp1252. (4) parseAttrs should return eof:true when input ends inside a tag, and tokenize should then return without yielding that tag. That fixes the failing expand-edge 'hostile input' case where `<a href="` at EOF became a self-link.
